findings.reason: Per-bucket publications track arrivals and the pending gauge stays small, so the delay is limited to the stuck rows.

findings.reason: No failure outcomes, near-zero handler time, no pool timeouts and no DB blockers, so no live fault explains the failed rows.

limitations: The window starts after the failed rows had already aged ~2000 s, so the original failure cause is outside the evidence.
